text:
Ellen Park: Windward Labs asked for a short POC to validate performance before contract sig. They want a plan to show sustained 2.8k req/s for templated summaries, tolerance for two 20s morning spikes at +160%, and a pricing comparison (1mo reserved, 3mo reserved, and hosted on-demand). p95 target <=200ms for <=140-token responses. Need a draft by EOD tomorrow.

Marcus Li: Quick clarifying question 11: is 2.8k mixed with embeddings or mostly generation? Also confirm avg tokens per request.

Ellen Park: Buyer: ~92% short generation (~120-140 tokens), ~6% medium (~320 tokens), ~2% embeddings. They prefer Dedicated but want hosted numbers too. They also asked about audit logs and key management.

Asha Verma: Proposed load profile: 12m gentle ramp to 2.8k, 25m steady, inject two 20s spikes at +160% spaced ~8m apart during steady state, then 5m cool-down. Capture cold-start (first 3m), steady-state, and burst tails. Metrics: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, tokens/sec, GPU util, and kv-cache hit-rate.

Marcus Li: Runner example (pseudo):

```
# pseudo runner
run-load --url https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat --rate 2800 --duration 00:42:00 \ 
  --spikes "20s:+160%@10m,20s:+160%@18m" --body windward_prompts.json \ 
  --hdr "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --out artifacts/windward-6210004321
```

Asha Verma: Ops notes: pin the model hash and disable background warmups for repeatability. For p95<=200ms during spikes recommend Dedicated with prefix KV cache enabled and autoscale min=2 max=6. If buyer insists on hosted only, call out tail risk from noisy neighbors and recommend burst credits + higher provisioned baseline.

Security Eng: For key mgmt, CMK without HSM is supported on Dedicated via our KMS proxy; HSM-backed BYOK requires Private and adds lead time. We can provide SOC2 report and log-forwarding; ask Windward for SIEM ingest method and retention requirements.

Marcus Li: Token math: ~130 tokens avg * 2800 req/s ~= 364k tokens/s. Back-of-envelope GPU sizing: for an open 30B FP16 with KV caching expect ~3 A100-eq; 4-bit quant could drop to 2. Ill run a sim and post precise GPU-seconds and per-GPU throughput tonight.

perf-runner-bot: scheduled run windward-poc-6210007000 (runner: perf-bastion-2).

Ops Lead: Runbook items: reserve staging pool min=2 max=6; pre-warm prefix cache; isolate medium requests to separate nodepool if memory thrash observed. Alerts: p95>300ms or error-rate>0.5%.

Ellen Park: Commercial asks: procurement wants 1mo and 3mo committed numbers and hosted on-demand. Include burst credits and overage per-token. Also provide a short appendix explaining why Dedicated reduces tail exposure (autoscale headroom + isolated GPU pools + prefix cache).

Marcus Li: Action items: run perf sim + GPU sizing (deliver by 9:30am PT tomorrow).
Asha Verma: Reserve staging pool & draft runbook (EOD).
Security Eng: Draft questionnaire answers for hosted/dedicated/private (EOD).
Ellen Park: I'll schedule a 30m alignment with Windward for tomorrow 8:30am PT and attach sample prompts + questionnaire.

Ellen Park: Any immediate blockers?

Asha Verma: None from operations; reserving now.

Marcus Li: Starting the sim now. Will pin model and force deterministic decoding to reduce variance.

perf-runner-bot: run started windward-poc-6210007000 (ETA ~30m).

Ellen Park: Thanks all 7a07a0. We'll reconvene after Marcus posts the sim artifacts and GPU sizing.
